import subprocess, json, time

proc = subprocess.Popen(["python3","/work/batch.py","live"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
time.sleep(0.3)
alive_before = proc.poll() is None
# read first progress line without blocking too long: read stderr line by line
line = proc.stderr.readline()
print("first stderr line:", line.strip())
print("alive after start event, before release:", proc.poll() is None)
proc.stdin.write("\n")
proc.stdin.flush()
out, err = proc.communicate(timeout=10)
print("exit code:", proc.returncode)
print("remaining stderr:\n", err)
print("stdout:\n", out)
print("alive_before(0.3s)=", alive_before)
